summary: Amerant Bancorp Inc. filed a preliminary prospectus supplement under Rule 424(b)(5) for an offering of senior unsecured notes maturing September 2031, with principal amount, coupon and pricing left blank pending completion. The notes pay interest semi-annually, are redeemable at par on or after six months prior to maturity with 10-60 days notice, rank equally with other unsecured unsubordinated debt, are not FDIC insured, and will not be listed. Raymond James is sole book-running manager. Proceeds are for general corporate purposes. This is a routine debt shelf takedown, not a special situation; watch final coupon, size and spread to peers.
